The '''Exoboar''' was a vicious burrowing creature native to the underground caves of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. Agile and armored with blaster-resistant leathery skin, exoboars were repelled by a particular herb growing in the caves.<ref name="codex" />

Exoboars were discovered by early [[Makeb]] settlers, who gave a species its name. Their exploration of the caves however, was brief and hindered, until [[Sarthon Quis]] figured out the effect of the aforementioned cave herbs, and how to use it for their advantage. Rubbing the herb on their clothes allowed the settlers to pass through the caves safely.<ref name="codex" />

One of the natural predators hunting exoboars was [[subteroth]].<ref name="codex" />
